contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A pierced copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend - no legend. Reverse shows Victory left on prow. Mint is Trier, AD 330-335. Obverse legend reads CONSTAN-TINOPOLIS. Obverse shows Helmeted bust left with sceptre over shoulder. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //TRP(dot). Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 1.62g, diameter is 18.7mm, thickness…
